primaries.name: Clarion-Clipperton Zone unnamed fauna under mining contracts
primaries.source: NHM CCZ checklist; Earth.com 2026-09-09; ISA 17 exploration contracts
primaries.known_fact: 5,578 animal species recorded in the CCZ; only 436 formally described; 88–92% lack names; 17 international exploration contracts sit on the same seafloor.
primaries.gap_statement: Extraction licensed against organisms that have no Red List identity, hence no legal death. Census is not a precondition of the license.
primaries.notes: Not DIC (the habitat, not a single seen specimen, is consumed). Not CIC (the issue is namelessness, not clock mismatch).

primaries.name: Katuš shortfall — unrecorded plant/fungal extinction
primaries.source: Kew, State of the World's Plants and Fungi 2026
primaries.known_fact: 29,748 plant species and 411 fungal species assessed as threatened; only 18% of plants and 0.6% of fungi have been assessed; >100,000 plant species and >2 million fungal species remain unnamed; 4,600 plants and 7,800 fungi newly named in 2024–2025; ghost palm Plectocomiopsis hantu named 92 years after first collection. Kew names this the Katuš shortfall: unrecorded loss of known AND unknown species.
primaries.gap_statement: An unnamed plant or fungus can go extinct without minting a death certificate. Red List cannot list what has no name. The loss is real; the record is structurally impossible.
primaries.notes: TODAY'S LOCK. Kew named the biodiversity instance. Class is the cross-realm remainder.
